data: What is the approximate value of the blue line when the total size is 16 GB?

Wait a moment, let me verify this. The blue line represents Hadoop's performance time in minutes for different total sizes in GB. At approximately 16 GB, the blue line shows an approximate value of around 30 minutes. This can be inferred by looking at the position of the blue line on the y-axis when the x-axis reaches 16 GB. Therefore, the approximate value of the blue line when the total size is 16 GB is 30 minutes.
The answer is 30.
